data.long_description:
Excellent opportunity to lease a premium retail unit in Jumeirah Village Circle at the sought-after Pearl House by Imtiaz. This 514 sq ft retail space is perfectly positioned on the main road, ensuring maximum visibility and footfall—ideal for cafes, boutiques, salons, or service-oriented businesses.

Strategically located in a high-density residential community, this unit offers strong exposure and easy accessibility, making it a great choice for brands looking to establish or expand in one of Dubai’s fastest-growing areas.

Property Details:

-Size: 514 sq ft
-Location: Main road facing
-Condition: Shell & Core / Ready for fit-out
-Rental Price: AED 170,000
-Payment Terms: 2 Cheques

Key Highlights:

-High foot traffic & excellent visibility
-Surrounded by residential buildings
-Easy access to major roads
-Ideal for various retail concepts

Secure your spot in a thriving community and elevate your business presence today.
